Interface IGame

All Known Implementing Classes:
Game
public interface IGame
Defines firing, shot statistics and board display for a game against a fleet.

  • Method Details

    • fire

      IShip fire(IPosition pos)
      Fires at a position and updates the corresponding shot statistics. Invalid or repeated shots do not damage ships or enter the shot history.
      Parameters:
      pos - the non-null target position
      Returns:
      the ship sunk by this shot, or null for a miss, an invalid or repeated shot, or a hit that does not sink a ship

    • getShots

      java.util.List<IPosition> getShots()

      Returns:
      the game's mutable shot list in firing order
